pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation; chest forward, head tilted up with a friendly grin.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree head-on view to keep the width narrow (max 260px).
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle looking up, making the sail look like a big, colorful fan.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Snout is rounded and shortened for a 'cute' profile. Tail and legs are hidden behind the bulk of the torso.

character_details.expression: Big, happy, curious eyes; a gentle closed-mouth smile (no scary teeth).
character_details.texture: Clean, 'vinyl-toy' skin texture. Color: Vibrant teal body with a sunset-gradient sail (yellow to pink).

environmental_details.ground: Stylized 'blue-glass' water with chunky, bright green mangrove leaves.
environmental_details.lighting: Warm 'Golden Hour' glow; soft purple ambient fill in the shadows to keep it looking 'sweet'.
